package fx

// Kinds holds every statement kind inside the branches of one if/else, so the
// P1 projection compared with the oracle visits each of them.
func Kinds(ch chan int, xs []int, v any) int {
	if len(xs) > 0 {
		var n int
		defer func() {}()
		;
		{
			n++
		}
		for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
			n += i
		}
		for _, x := range xs {
			n += x
		}
		go func() { ch <- 1 }()
		select {
		case m := <-ch:
			n += m
		default:
		}
		switch n {
		case 1:
			n--
		}
		switch t := v.(type) {
		case int:
			n += t
		}
	L:
		for {
			break L
		}
		return n
	} else {
		ch <- 0
	}
	return 0
}
